posts.body_html: Here's a few different clones of S. minor from Old Dock, Columbus Co, NC. I'm really starting to like this population of plants, and now I'm really starting to see why these are called minors-they're pretty short! Okee giants really makes these minors look small!

posts.body_html: It was a hot summer day last year and Brie and I were casually looking at the different Sarracenia plants that were brought to first -and to date, only- Northwest CP gathering. I was telling her about my great fondness for S. minor and following a rather expressive uttering of "I just love minors", a smirk formed on her face. A few seconds later I caught up w/ her thought process.... I've yet to live those words down. To mark the year anniversary of this special moment, I've created this image based on her rendition of the events.
